Nicolas Robinson-Garcia is associate professor in the field of bibliometrics and research evaluation at the University of Granada. He is interested in understanding how collaboration and social organization shape the way science works and the diversity of career paths scientists follow. He is scientific director of the Unit for Computational Humanities and Social Sciences (U^CHASS) and member of the EC3 Research Group. He is co-editor of the journal Research Evaluation and member of the editorial board of Quantitative Science Studies.

Diversidad y reconocimiento en la academia


Author: Nicolás Robinson-García Publisher: UOC (Universitat Oberta de Catalunya) · Year: 2025 ISBN: 978 84 11661805


La imagen del científico aislado en su laboratorio pertenece al pasado. Hoy, la ciencia es un esfuerzo colectivo en el que la diversidad ?de ideas, trayectorias y perspectivas? es clave para generar conocimiento que refleje la complejidad del mundo en que vivimos. Este libro explora cómo se reconoce y valora la contribución de los científicos, qué retos afronta el sistema académico y cómo podemos avanzar hacia una evaluación más justa e inclusiva. Una lectura imprescindible para investigadores, gestores y cualquier persona interesada en entender cómo se hace ciencia en el siglo XXI.

title: Outreach
text:
Academic service
In addition to research and teaching, I engage in applied academic work in collaboration with public institutions, funding agencies, and research organisations. This work focuses on research evaluation, bibliometrics, and science policy, and typically involves methodological design, analytical reports, and expert advice grounded in responsible and context-sensitive use of indicators.
Areas of expertise

Bibliometric and scientometric analyses
Design and assessment of research evaluation frameworks
Analysis of scientific collaboration, careers, and research trajectories
Methodological advice on data sources, indicators, and responsible metrics

Selected institutional collaborations

Bibliometric analyses and reports for Fulbright Spain or EC3Metrics among others
Research evaluation and assessment activities for public entities such as European Commission, the US National Science Foundation, the Swiss National Science Foundation or the Spanish Agencia Estatal de Investigación.
Advisory work for the International Centre for the Study of Research

If you are interested in collaboration or applied academic work related to research evaluation, bibliometrics, or science policy, feel free to get in touch.
